mapper.select: SELECT b.*, c.name as category_name, COALESCE(SUM(s.available_qty), 0) as available_qty, COALESCE(SUM(s.total_qty), 0) as total_qty FROM book b LEFT JOIN category c ON b.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN stock s ON b.id = s.book_id WHERE b.id = #{id} GROUP BY b.id
